description: Generate GIF, JPG, and PNG preview thumbnails, overwriting any existing preview files.
inputInstructions: overwriteExistingPreviewFiles (true/false) controls whether existing .previewFile.* thumbnails are replaced, and is set by the "Overwrite existing preview files" field. outputType is a comma-separated list of thumbnail formats to emit (.gif, .jpg, .png).

tagSchema.label: Overwrite existing preview files
tagSchema.description: Replace an existing .previewFile.* thumbnail for the input file. Clear it to leave an existing thumbnail in place, which reports the run successful without regenerating.
